findings.description: The server command of campaign22 (easy), campaign23 (hard) and campaign24 (chaos) contains -Dachievetodo.progression.freshConfig=true in addition to -javaagent:plugins/achievetodo.jar and the trace agent. The brief states the certified operator launch has no -Dachievetodo.* flags; only campaign21 and campaign25 match. The flag changes config resolution (BukkitProgressionRuntime.java:72, :401 'explicit freshConfig required'), and ReleaseLaunchProfile.java:85 only derives it itself when it writes a new world group, which the logged derived=[...] list for these runtimes does not include. So the thresholds-easy/hard/chaos rows of this group were produced outside the certified composition. ATD_LAUNCH_PROFILE=release and ATD_GAMEPLAY_MODE=CERTIFICATION are logged in all five runtimes (output.log lines ~206-222).

No landmark excerpt contains an explicit plugin denial line: ATD_W2_INPUT_EVENT/ATD_EVENT read useBlock=ALLOW, cancelled=false and the STAGE2A state reports "INTERACT_INSIDE_*": null. The lock is shown only by the missing OpenScreen packet, unchanged count and the client overlay in rows.jsonl.
